review.summary: The copy exceeds the destination buffer.

findings.title: Oversized memory copy
findings.explanation: sizeof(source) includes six bytes while destination holds only four.
findings.suggested_fix: Copy no more than destination's size or use a destination large enough for source.

review.summary: A moved-from unique pointer is dereferenced.

findings.title: Dereference after move
findings.explanation: Moving item transfers ownership and leaves item empty before this dereference.
findings.suggested_fix: Read owner->id or access item before moving it.

review.summary: The returned view refers to a temporary string.

findings.title: Dangling string view
findings.explanation: The temporary std::string is destroyed before the caller can use the view.
findings.suggested_fix: Return std::string by value or view storage owned by the caller.

findings.title: Signed multiplication overflow
findings.explanation: Multiplying a sufficiently large units value overflows signed int, which is undefined behavior.
findings.suggested_fix: Return long long and calculate 1LL * units * 1000000; validate any remaining application limit.

review.summary: The same data is copied and sorted repeatedly.

findings.title: Repeated full sort
findings.explanation: Each iteration copies and sorts unchanged values one hundred times.
findings.suggested_fix: Copy and sort once before the loop, then reuse the median element.

review.summary: Prepending shifts the existing result on every iteration.

findings.title: Repeated front insertion
findings.explanation: Each insert at position zero moves the accumulated output, producing avoidable quadratic work.
findings.suggested_fix: Append in reverse order or use an output strategy that avoids repeated front insertion.

review.summary: Zero is incorrectly accepted as a power of two.
assumptions: Zero is not a power of two.

findings.title: Zero passes the bit test
findings.explanation: For value zero, value - 1 wraps and the expression evaluates true.
findings.suggested_fix: Require value != 0 before applying the bit test.

review.summary: An exactly available quantity is rejected.
assumptions: Shipping is allowed when available equals requested.

findings.title: Equality is excluded
findings.explanation: The strict greater-than comparison returns false when available and requested are equal.
findings.suggested_fix: Use available >= requested if an exact quantity is sufficient.

review.summary: The regular expression is compiled for every value.

findings.title: Repeated regular-expression construction
findings.explanation: Constructing std::regex inside the loop repeats parsing and compilation for an unchanged pattern.
findings.suggested_fix: Construct the regex once before the loop and reuse it for each value.
